description: Bilingual FAO-56 retrieval benchmark. Gold evidence is given as anchors (page id + phrases that must all occur in a chunk), resolved to chunk ids at evaluation time. Every anchor was copied from the parsed corpus (2026-11-06) and is checked by tests/test_knowledge.py. Questions were written by the implementer after the glossary; they are not in the indexed documents.
